subject: Uncontrolled Intersections and Vision Zero
overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission discussed roadway safety following a member's collision at an uncontrolled intersection, voting to send a letter to the city advocating for stop signs and signage at similar intersections. The commission also reviewed Vision Zero policy ideas, updates to the city's draft bicycle network map, and approved purchasing an additional batch of bike lights.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from the June, July, and August meetings.

items.title: Announcements and Harvest Your Energy Festival
items.summary: Announced the upcoming Harvest Your Energy Festival scheduled for October 15, encouraging members to attend.

items.title: Uncontrolled Intersections and Letter to the City
items.summary: Approved a motion to send a letter to city officials and the City Council requesting traffic signage, stop signs, and pothole repairs at uncontrolled and blind intersections across the city, prompted by Ernie Meunier's recent bicycle crash at Smith Lane and Woburn Street.

items.title: Vision Zero and Complete Streets Strategy
items.summary: Discussed advocating for the city to adopt a Vision Zero policy and agreed that interested members could participate in an informal working group with WalkMedford to draft proposals.

items.title: Commission Membership
items.summary: Noted the resignation of member Dana Phillips and considered the timeline for recommending new appointees.

items.title: Bicycle Master Plan and Draft Network Map Update
items.summary: Guest Lily Wirth shared updates on three new operational Bluebikes stations and presented a draft Google Maps layer of potential on-street bicycle infrastructure connections for member review and feedback.

items.title: Bike Light Distribution and Purchase Approval
items.summary: Approved a motion authorizing Ernie Meunier to order 240 additional bike light kits for student distribution throughout the fall.

items.title: Bike to School Day
items.summary: Announced that WalkMedford's Bike to School Day will take place on October 12, seeking volunteers to lead student bike convoys.
